scope.purpose: Provide controlled, independently encoded vocabulary axes for NeuroAI landscape discovery, classification, evaluation, expert review, and later bounded capability-context governance mapping.
non_claims: Taxonomy assignment does not establish NeuroAI inclusion.
Taxonomy assignment does not establish product effectiveness, regulatory authorization, commercialization, or patent-product linkage.
Taxonomy assignment does not authorize canonical S2 mutation, publication, or v4.2 assessment findings.
Gray-third tags do not define a complete or canonical population class.
Model agreement does not establish governed truth.
scope.axis_independence_rule: Sensing modality, inferred state, intervention/output capability, product form factor, deployment context, and regulatory/scientific claim state must be encoded independently. Absence or presence on one axis must not be silently inferred from another axis.

classification_policy.proxy_only_rule: A product or system observed only through non-neural physiological proxy signals cannot be classified as NeuroAI solely from that sensing evidence. Independent evidence must establish a neural, neurocognitive, or neural-interaction function within the research-contract boundary, and governed inclusion remains a separate disposition.
classification_policy.evidence_rule: Assign a controlled term only when an attributable source observation supports the exact axis value. Preserve uncertainty and source/observation references outside this vocabulary artifact.
classification_policy.model_role: Models may propose one or more controlled IDs with confidence and rationale for review. They may not approve G1, decide canonical inclusion, create substantive truth, or resolve expert disagreement by consensus.

sensing_modality.label: Intracortical electrophysiology
sensing_modality.definition: Electrical neural activity recorded with electrodes placed within brain tissue.

sensing_modality.label: Electrocorticography (ECoG)
sensing_modality.definition: Electrical neural activity recorded from electrodes placed on or near the cortical surface.

sensing_modality.label: Scalp electroencephalography (EEG)
sensing_modality.definition: Electrical activity measured non-invasively from electrodes positioned on the scalp.

sensing_modality.label: Ear-EEG
sensing_modality.definition: EEG-like electrical neural signals measured using electrodes positioned in or around the ear.

sensing_modality.label: Magnetoencephalography (MEG)
sensing_modality.definition: Magnetic fields generated by neural electrical activity measured outside the head.

sensing_modality.label: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS)
sensing_modality.definition: Optical measurement of cerebral hemodynamic changes used as an indirect signal of neural activity.

sensing_modality.label: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI)
sensing_modality.definition: MRI-based measurement of hemodynamic changes used as an indirect signal of neural activity.

sensing_modality.label: Functional ultrasound neuroimaging
sensing_modality.definition: Ultrasound-based measurement of cerebral blood-flow dynamics used as an indirect signal of neural activity.

sensing_modality.label: Peripheral nerve electrophysiology
sensing_modality.definition: Electrical activity recorded from peripheral nerves or nerve interfaces.

sensing_modality.label: Electromyography (EMG)
sensing_modality.definition: Electrical activity measured from skeletal muscle and used as a physiological or motor proxy signal.

sensing_modality.label: Electrooculography (EOG)
sensing_modality.definition: Electrical potential associated with eye movement used as an ocular or physiological proxy signal.

sensing_modality.label: Cardiovascular proxy sensing
sensing_modality.definition: Cardiovascular measurements such as ECG or photoplethysmography used as physiological proxy signals.

sensing_modality.label: Electrodermal proxy sensing
sensing_modality.definition: Electrodermal activity used as a physiological proxy signal for arousal-related processes.

sensing_modality.label: Multimodal neural and physiological sensing
sensing_modality.definition: A system that jointly uses at least one neural or neurovascular modality and one or more physiological proxy modalities.

sensing_modality.label: No sensing / output-only
sensing_modality.definition: The observed capability involves intervention or output without a sensing modality evidenced in the scoped observation.

sensing_modality.label: Unknown sensing modality
sensing_modality.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to identify the sensing modality.

sensing_modality.label: Other sensing modality — review required
sensing_modality.definition: Observed sensing does not fit the controlled vocabulary and requires review before a new term or mapping is introduced.

inferred_state.label: Motor intent or movement state
inferred_state.definition: Inference of intended or ongoing movement-related neural or neurophysiological state.

inferred_state.label: Sensory or perceptual state
inferred_state.definition: Inference of a sensory, perceptual, or stimulus-related state.

inferred_state.label: Speech or language content/state
inferred_state.definition: Inference of speech-related, language-related, or communicative content or state.

inferred_state.label: Attention or vigilance
inferred_state.definition: Inference of attention, vigilance, or engagement-related state.

inferred_state.label: Fatigue or drowsiness
inferred_state.definition: Inference of fatigue, drowsiness, or alertness-related state.

inferred_state.label: Cognitive load or workload
inferred_state.definition: Inference of cognitive load, mental workload, or task-demand-related state.

inferred_state.label: Affect or emotion
inferred_state.definition: Inference of affective or emotion-related state.

inferred_state.label: Stress or arousal
inferred_state.definition: Inference of stress- or arousal-related state; proxy-only physiological evidence does not independently establish NeuroAI inclusion.

inferred_state.label: Readiness or performance state
inferred_state.definition: Inference of readiness, performance capacity, or related operational state.

inferred_state.label: Sleep state
inferred_state.definition: Inference or classification of sleep stage, sleep/wake state, or related sleep condition.

inferred_state.label: Memory or recognition-related state
inferred_state.definition: Inference of memory, recognition, or related cognitive state.

inferred_state.label: Clinical neurological state
inferred_state.definition: Inference or classification of a neurological state used within a clinical or investigational context.

inferred_state.label: Pain-related state
inferred_state.definition: Inference or classification of pain-related state.

inferred_state.label: No inferred state
inferred_state.definition: The scoped capability does not infer a user state; for example, it may directly relay signals or deliver intervention.

inferred_state.label: Unknown inferred state
inferred_state.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to identify an inferred state.

inferred_state.label: Other inferred state — review required
inferred_state.definition: Observed inference target does not fit the controlled vocabulary and requires review.

intervention_output_capability.label: Observation or measurement only
intervention_output_capability.definition: The scoped system measures or infers without an evidenced adaptive output or intervention.

intervention_output_capability.label: Neurofeedback or state feedback
intervention_output_capability.definition: Feedback is provided to the user based on neural, neurovascular, or adjudicated NeuroAI state information.

intervention_output_capability.label: Adaptive interface or content
intervention_output_capability.definition: Interface, content, or device behavior adapts using an evidenced neural or adjudicated NeuroAI state signal.

intervention_output_capability.label: Personalization or recommendation
intervention_output_capability.definition: Recommendation or personalization changes using an evidenced neural or adjudicated NeuroAI state signal.

intervention_output_capability.label: Communication output
intervention_output_capability.definition: Neural or adjudicated NeuroAI signals are converted into communicative output such as text, speech, or symbol selection.

intervention_output_capability.label: Device or environment control
intervention_output_capability.definition: Neural or adjudicated NeuroAI signals control a device, cursor, environment, or software function.

intervention_output_capability.label: Robotic or prosthetic control
intervention_output_capability.definition: Neural or adjudicated NeuroAI signals control a robotic, prosthetic, or assistive actuator.

intervention_output_capability.label: Safety or vigilance alert
intervention_output_capability.definition: The system emits an alert or warning based on an inferred state such as drowsiness, fatigue, or vigilance.

intervention_output_capability.label: Clinical decision support
intervention_output_capability.definition: The system produces information intended to support a clinical decision; this label does not establish clinical validity or authorization.

intervention_output_capability.label: Central electrical stimulation
intervention_output_capability.definition: Electrical stimulation is delivered to the central nervous system or brain.

intervention_output_capability.label: Central magnetic stimulation
intervention_output_capability.definition: Magnetic stimulation is delivered to influence central neural activity.

intervention_output_capability.label: Central ultrasound stimulation
intervention_output_capability.definition: Ultrasound is delivered with the intended function of influencing central neural activity.

intervention_output_capability.label: Peripheral nerve stimulation
intervention_output_capability.definition: Stimulation is delivered to a peripheral nerve or peripheral neural interface.

intervention_output_capability.label: Unknown intervention/output capability
intervention_output_capability.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to identify an intervention or output capability.

intervention_output_capability.label: Other intervention/output — review required
intervention_output_capability.definition: Observed output or intervention does not fit the controlled vocabulary and requires review.

product_form_factor.label: Implanted brain interface
product_form_factor.definition: Implanted system whose interface is located within or on the brain or cranial neural structures.

product_form_factor.label: Implanted peripheral neural interface
product_form_factor.definition: Implanted system interfacing with peripheral nerves.

product_form_factor.label: Headset, cap, or helmet
product_form_factor.definition: Head-worn system using a headset, cap, helmet, or comparable cranial form factor.

product_form_factor.label: Earable or hearable
product_form_factor.definition: In-ear, around-ear, or ear-adjacent wearable form factor.

product_form_factor.label: Eyewear
product_form_factor.definition: Glasses, visor, or comparable eyewear form factor.

product_form_factor.label: XR headset
product_form_factor.definition: Virtual-, augmented-, or mixed-reality headset containing or coupled to the observed NeuroAI capability.

product_form_factor.label: Skin patch or electrode array
product_form_factor.definition: Patch, adhesive, or externally placed electrode-array form factor.

product_form_factor.label: Body wearable
product_form_factor.definition: Wearable device positioned on the body outside the head/ear/eye categories.

product_form_factor.label: Handheld or desktop system
product_form_factor.definition: Handheld, desktop, or stationary user-facing device.

product_form_factor.label: Clinical equipment
product_form_factor.definition: Clinical or diagnostic equipment whose physical form is primarily defined by clinical use rather than consumer wearability.

product_form_factor.label: Robotic or prosthetic system
product_form_factor.definition: Robotic, prosthetic, or assistive physical system containing or controlled by the observed capability.

product_form_factor.label: Software-only layer
product_form_factor.definition: Software or model layer operating on externally supplied signals without a distinct hardware form factor in the scoped product identity.

product_form_factor.label: Research platform or component
product_form_factor.definition: Research-oriented platform, module, SDK, sensor component, or subsystem not necessarily sold as a complete end-user product.

product_form_factor.label: Unknown form factor
product_form_factor.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to identify product form factor.

product_form_factor.label: Other form factor — review required
product_form_factor.definition: Observed form factor does not fit the controlled vocabulary and requires review.

deployment_context.label: Clinical diagnosis or monitoring
deployment_context.definition: Use in clinical diagnosis, monitoring, or clinical assessment.

deployment_context.label: Clinical treatment or rehabilitation
deployment_context.definition: Use for treatment, therapy, rehabilitation, or clinical intervention.

deployment_context.label: Assistive or accessibility use
deployment_context.definition: Use to enable communication, control, access, or functional assistance for a user.

deployment_context.label: Research or laboratory use
deployment_context.definition: Use primarily in research, experimental, or laboratory settings.

deployment_context.label: Consumer wellness
deployment_context.definition: Consumer-facing wellness, self-tracking, relaxation, or non-clinical personal use.

deployment_context.label: Sports or performance
deployment_context.definition: Use in sports, training, readiness, or performance optimization contexts.

deployment_context.label: Workplace or employment
deployment_context.definition: Use in employment, workforce management, occupational performance, or worker monitoring contexts.

deployment_context.label: Transportation or operator safety
deployment_context.definition: Use in driving, aviation, transport, or safety-critical operator monitoring contexts.

deployment_context.label: Education or training
deployment_context.definition: Use in formal or informal education, learning, tutoring, or skill-training contexts.

deployment_context.label: Gaming, XR, or entertainment
deployment_context.definition: Use in gaming, immersive media, entertainment, or interactive experience contexts.

deployment_context.label: Defense or security
deployment_context.definition: Use in defense, military, intelligence, or security contexts; the tag records observed context and does not infer intent or misuse.

deployment_context.label: Industrial or operational use
deployment_context.definition: Use in industrial operations, human-machine teaming, or operational control contexts outside transportation.

deployment_context.label: Home or smart environment
deployment_context.definition: Use in home automation, ambient computing, or domestic smart-environment contexts.

deployment_context.label: Unknown deployment context
deployment_context.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to identify deployment context.

deployment_context.label: Other deployment context — review required
deployment_context.definition: Observed deployment context does not fit the controlled vocabulary and requires review.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: Explicit regulatory authorization/clearance evidence
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: An attributable regulatory source explicitly documents an authorization, clearance, approval, or equivalent status for an exact scoped product/use; jurisdiction and scope must be retained in the evidence record.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: Investigational regulatory state
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: Evidence explicitly indicates investigational, trial, experimental, or equivalent non-market authorization status in the relevant jurisdiction/context.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: Regulatory status unresolved
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: Observed evidence does not support a jurisdiction-specific regulatory-status conclusion.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: Peer-reviewed evidence reported
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: A peer-reviewed source reports evaluation relevant to the scoped capability; this tag does not by itself establish effectiveness, generalizability, or regulatory status.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: Preprint or conference evidence reported
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: A preprint or conference source reports evaluation relevant to the scoped capability; evidence status remains distinct from peer review and regulatory authorization.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: Company-reported validation
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: The company or product source reports validation or performance evidence; the claim remains source-attributed and is not independently established by this tag.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: Marketing or product-function claim reported
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: A company/product source represents a function or benefit without sufficient independent evidence in the scoped record to elevate the claim state.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: No effectiveness claim observed
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: The scoped observation contains no effectiveness claim; this does not establish absence across all sources or time.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: Unknown regulatory/scientific claim state
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to classify regulatory/scientific claim state.

regulatory_scientific_claim_state.label: Other claim state — review required
regulatory_scientific_claim_state.definition: Observed claim/evidence state does not fit the controlled vocabulary and requires review.

gray_third.definition: Gray-third tags are capability-first discovery and boundary-validation aids for applications that may be missed by conventional clinical/scientific neurotechnology terminology. They do not establish NeuroAI inclusion or a complete population.

search_families.label: Adaptive interfaces
examples: content or device adapts to neural or physiological state

search_families.label: Behavioral personalization
examples: closed-loop recommendation or personalization using brain/body-state signals

search_families.label: Nontraditional sensing form factors
examples: wearables with neural or near-neural sensing

mapping_scaffold.unit: observed capability deployed in an evidenced context

mechanisms.label: Continuous or repeated state monitoring
mechanisms.definition: A capability supports repeated or continuous inference/measurement of a person-related neural or neurocognitive state.

mechanisms.label: Adaptive decision, interface, or content
mechanisms.definition: An inferred state changes content, recommendations, interface behavior, access, or a system decision.

mechanisms.label: Closed-loop intervention
mechanisms.definition: Observed sensing or inference informs an intervention delivered within a closed-loop process.

mechanisms.label: Sensitive neural-data processing
mechanisms.definition: The capability processes neural or neurocognitive data whose collection, inference, retention, linkage, or reuse can be governance-relevant.

mechanisms.label: Deployment under power asymmetry
mechanisms.definition: The observed context places the data subject or user in a materially asymmetric institutional relationship, such as employment or another controlled setting.

mechanisms.label: Other mechanism — review required
mechanisms.definition: A proposed mechanism is outside the controlled scaffold and requires review before use.

mapping_scaffold.bounded_language_template: could implicate concern {concern} under conditions {conditions} through mechanism {mechanism}
prohibited_assertion_templates: company or product will cause harm X
